shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!*node_modules*'"' -g '"'!*.lock'"' | sort | sed -n '1,240p' && git status --short && find . -name AGENTS.md -print"

/bin/bash -lc 'for f in package.json tsconfig.json next.config.ts pages/_app.tsx pages/_document.tsx pages/index.tsx pages/about.tsx; do echo "### $f"; sed -n '"'1,240p' \""'$f"; done; find . -maxdepth 3 -type f '"\\( -name '*.css' -o -name '*.scss' \\) -print"
/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- package.json; git diff --no-index /dev/null package-lock.json | sed -n '1,100p' || true; find public -maxdepth 2 -type f -print 2>/dev/null || true; ls -la"
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff -- app tsconfig.json pages && find app -maxdepth 3 -type f -print | sort && test ! -d pages'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' .gitignore; sed -n '1,100p' next-env.d.ts; git diff --stat; git diff -- app || true"
/bin/bash -lc 'for route in / /about; do curl --fail --silent --show-error "http://localhost:3000$route" | tr '"'>' '>\\n' | rg -o '["'^<]+|<h1>[''^<]+|<p>[''^<]+'"'; done"
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff --check && find app -maxdepth 3 -type f -print | sort && test ! -d pages'
